climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A group of four wine regions around Buda and the upper Danube: Etyek-Buda, Neszmély, Mór and Pannonhalma. Its limestone-based soil makes only white wine, with Chardonnay, Sauvignon Blanc, Riesling, Tramini and Muscat Ottonel playing a significant role.
